name: evowerk-cloud-mrp
description: Root task runner and npm workspace (frontend/), same commands as the Makefile, works without make (plain Windows).

scripts.setup: npm ci && cd backend && uv sync --frozen
scripts.test: npm run test:backend && npm run test:frontend
scripts.lint: cd backend && uv run ruff check . && cd .. && npm --workspace frontend run lint
scripts.build: npm --workspace frontend run build && docker compose build
